case_name: Shaikh Ali Hossain And Ors. v Sh. Showkat Ali And Anr.
holding: The High Court was not justified in interfering with the order of the trial court and appellate court rejecting the application for temporary injunction. The view taken by the High Court is not warranted and calls for interference.
